digest.component_or_area: Jira reconcile bridge, comment deduplication system
propositions: The primary comment deduplication guard (binding_store.is_comment_mapped) was inert in production for six days because the comment_ids map was never populated, despite the guard being present and correct in code.

No test exercised the end-to-end dedup path (apply-phase recording followed by differ-phase skip against the same store); each layer seeded the invariant the other layer should have established, permitting total failure to pass all tests.
Review-time criteria (E4, T3, T5b) had scope boundaries that stopped short of silently-inert guards on external-system dependencies; the code-review rubric naming this shape was added post-escape.

A silent return on correctness-critical guard conditions left no operator-readable signal that a feature's primary dedup mechanism was non-functional while fallback deduplication (body-equality skip) masked the failure as partial success.
